QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Flame Bird Support
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bDefense Mission - Flame Bird Support#k#n

#bMission Period#k
12/12/2018 8:00 PM - 12/25/2018 11:59 PM

The Flame Birds have been helping many warriors at the Arcane River. Now, they're joining forces to save the world from crisis.
Learn the#b Call Flame Bird#k skill and#b right-click#k to summon a Flame Bird.
You can acquire#b determination#k if you#b defeat monsters near your level#k while the Flame Bird is summoned. The more determination you gain, the bigger the Flame Bird will#b grow#k.
Not only that, when the Flame Bird consumes a certain amount of determination, its#b fire energy gets stronger#k. When the fire energy#b reaches its max#k, the Flame Bird will carry your character on its back and wipe out nearby enemies.

#bYou cannot summon the Flame Bird once you've collected 50,000 determination for the day.#k
#bYou cannot summon the Flame Bird in some areas, including Tenebris.#k
